supersedes: dynamic_admission_v4_nonblocking_bridge only for new evidence; prior valid refusal remains archived
trigger: Only when a healthy UAV's measured horizontal velocity exceeds the unchanged 1.5 m/s component limit at the failure event
hold: Freeze the healthy UAV's goal at its failure-event position, command zero nominal velocity, and continue RA filtering
recheck: After three consecutive measured samples with each horizontal velocity component <=1.45 m/s, evaluate the existing dynamic gate exactly once from the current measured states and failed-vehicle braking envelope
timeout: At 2.0 s without stability, reject permanently and retain safe hold; missing or non-finite velocity cannot count as stable
preserve: Original v4 geometry, seeds, order, RA settings, clearance, route candidates, rollout, and valid negative result are unchanged
sequence: Run all calibration conditions from first seed in a new output root; only GO permits qualification, only qualification GO permits sealed and dependent comparison
stop_rule: After completing a paired case, an admission or safe-hold failure stops dependent later cases; valid baselines remain results, infrastructure invalidity is retried same seed, and no effective failure is discarded
